notes: Ability damage is parsed from Riot's game data (CommunityDragon) and tooltips: every number tagged as magic, physical or true damage, evaluated at level 18 with max ranks. scaling keys: const, ap, bonus_ad, bonus_hp, bonus_armor, bonus_mr, as (bonus attack speed), crit, lethality.
target is flat or a fraction of the target's max/current/missing health. alt marks numbers that look like alternatives (empowered, maximum, recast) rather than extra hits.
mayhem holds the ARAM Mayhem damage dealt/taken modifiers and listed changes (aramnerfs.com).
cn holds 101.qq.com China-server Mayhem stats: damage_share is the average share of the team's damage.
